value.description: The picker's color, when the caller controls it. The picker keeps its color in this value's color space.

defaultValue.description: The starting color, when the picker controls itself. It also sets the color space the picker keeps its color in.

disabled.description: Disables every Mux UI color control inside the picker, at any depth. A child cannot turn it off, and native elements inside are not affected.

readOnly.description: Makes every Mux UI color control inside the picker read-only, at any depth. A child cannot turn it off, and native elements inside are not affected.

change.description: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time a color control inside changes it, in the color space of the value, or of defaultValue when uncontrolled, and in rgba() form with neither. A disabled or read-only picker does not call it.

MuxUIColorValue.description: A CSS color string. A color control's onChange returns one in the color space of its value, of an enclosing ColorPicker's color, or of its defaultValue: rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex and rgb, hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for hsl and hsb. ColorSlider with colorSpace uses that space, and ColorSwatchPicker returns the chosen item's color.
